subject: reasoning
question:
How many mobiles are not battery? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/490fa1bbe4eea1beb2249c83fe6d1d9d4f2d05a3270c3c110cf97af4fdabb6aa.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d02b6742bf6a6c7661fb97fa32e3fd2e3630f79dea7f767e099a43b0844be37d.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of mobiles are not battery".

So, the total number of mobiles are not battery = 5 + 9 = 14.

Hence, the correct answer is "14".
